parallelism.notes: Driver loop is tiny (~few thousand ml rows after LT filter); parallelism overhead not worth it. Dim builds (CN_ids bitset, seq_movies bitset) are sequential CSR/scan.

per-mv range scan for note/ct/cn check

implementation_notes: company_name has varlen name and fixed country_code; iterate rows and set CN_ids[i] when both predicates hold.
Resolve ct_pc by scanning company_type (4 rows). Resolve k_sequel by scanning keyword (binary on kind not needed; linear scan is fine but if a sorted/index exists use it).
ml note: ml row stride small; capture both movie_id and link_type_id (->lt.link) at filter time. Track running MIN(lt.link) candidates only for ml rows whose mv ends up surviving.
title is sorted by id; production_year[mv-1] direct access (mv is 1-based title id).
movie_info range: stop EXISTS scan on first match.
movie_companies range: short-circuit on first qualifying mc row (note empty AND company_type_id==ct_pc AND CN_ids[company_id]). Capture cn.name for MIN.
Per surviving (mv, ml row), capture (cn.name, lt.link, t.title) and fold into 3 scalar MINs.
